 Arshdeep scalps Santner; NZ 7 down
 Fri, 13 November 2026 
 Share: 
 10:52 
 NZ 294-7 (45 ovs) vs India |  Scorecard 
 Naman Dhir with a fresh over and Kristian Clarke steers a tossed up delivery to deep mid-wicket for a single and brings Mitchell Santner on strike.  
 Six! In the slot and Santner smokes it over the long-off fence.  
 A dot later, Santner goes big again and gets another six over the long-on fence.  
 A dot and a single to end the 14-run over.  
 Kuldeep Yadav continues and Santner and Clarke keep the score-board ticking with two singles and a couple. Just four off the over.  
 Arshdeep Singh with his eighth over and will come around the wicket. Clarke pulls the first delivery flat and Naman Dhir does well to keep it for a single.  
 Out! Santner goes, caught by Ishan Kishan. Shortish delivery outside off and the NZ skipper looks to prod but the ball shapes away and takes an outside edge and carries to the keeper.  
 Santner departs for 24 off 29 balls with 1 boundary and two sixes.  
 Kyle Jamieson comes to the crease and plays out three dots before opening his account with a single to third man.  
 Just two runs came off the over.
